plan.title: Subscription Plan
plan.description: Select your subscription tier. free = all 42 tools available for trial (with OCR / bulk / autonomous workflow gated), starter = production use with OCR + bulk generation + audit log + annual report (19,800 JPY/mo), professional = full feature set with legal search + autonomous workflow (49,800 JPY/mo).

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: SuguVisa API key issued from https://suguvisa.com/dashboard/api-keys. Required for starter / professional plans; optional for the free tier (unauthenticated access uses stricter rate limits).

gcpProjectId.title: GCP Project ID (Optional)
gcpProjectId.description: Your own Google Cloud Project ID for residence card OCR (Document AI) and legal document search (Vertex AI). Leave empty to use SuguVisa's managed quota.
